_readme: Where a map's DESCRIPTIONS and its CODE disagree. `claimed_not_run` = the prose names a concept no artifact's script executes. `run_not_claimed` = the code runs something no description mentions. The four ubiquitous code terms (array, point, loop, colour — each >90% of scripts) are excluded: they would drown the join. Maps where less than half the cast had a readable script are skipped, because absence of code is not absence of the concept.
